name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, document roots, static content, site enablement, and service management. Also applies TLS, Fail2ban, firewall, sysctl, and SSH hardening configuration.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and port 6379, creates the Redis log directory, and applies the required Redis configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python tooling, a Git checkout, virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
